Every track here is by <b>Aethra Kairos<: Kowace waƙa a nan ta Aethra Kairos ce, kuma injin Möbius⁸ ne ke zana hotuna. Yana karanta kowace waƙa a ainihin lokaci — farkon sauti, kuzari, da fasalin sauti — kuma yana yanke fage, launuka, da kyamara don su dace. An tsara sifar ta ta wurin aiki mai daidaitawa, φ(x) = 2·arctan x, don kallon ya kasance daure ga sauti maimakon ga zaɓi na bazuwar: girman igiyar sauti da mitar sauti suna sanya kowane sashen mitar a sarari, da lemu a gefe ɗaya da ƙanƙara a ɗaya.

The scene responds to your input: <b>dra: Fage yana amsa abin da ka bayar: ja domin tuƙa kyamara (kayan wuta na auto yana jira yayin da kake riƙe da shi), gyaggyara domin kusanci ko nisanta, danna-sau-biyu domin aika girgizar-hoto ta cikin fage. Taɓawarka tana da hali — kuma tana bayyana shi, cikin launukan kiɗan kanta: ramin baƙi yana sanye da zoben haske mai walƙiya inda hasken taurari yake karkacewa kewaye da iyakarsa; vortex yana lallaɓe hannayen karkace na gaskiya waɗanda ke ci gaba da juyawa bayan ka jefa su; accretion shi ne diski na ƙura da ake ganin suna kewayawa suna kuma faɗawa cikin riƙonka; raƙuman ruwa suna birgima waje a matsayin zoben-zobe na gaskiya waɗanda ke ƙaruwa haske a kan bugu. Riƙe, sai baka mai sirara ta cika yayin da taɓawa ke ajiye ƙarfi; sake shi sai cajin ya fashe kamar rafin igiya daga wurin ɗagawa — jefar da shi cikin sauri domin fashewa mafi girma. Ƙwaƙƙwafin taɓawa (ko sauya-sheƙa na nutsewa) yana canza halin; AUTO yana barin kowane fage ya sake daidaita shi. Yatsu biyu lokaci guda suna dasa cibiyoyi biyu masu ƙarfi na akasi — rijiya a kan wofi, majiyoyin raƙuman-ruwa guda biyu suna karo da junansu — kuma ma'aunin sararin yana lanƙwasa haske ta cikin dukansu biyu. Kowane fage yana sake jefa sifofinsa duk lokacin da ya bayyana, kuma yanayin ayyuka biyar — OVERTURE · RISING · APEX · TURN · RESOLVE — yana bin kowace waƙa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, yana karkatar da kyamara, zafin launi, da saurin sauyawa zuwa inda waƙar take.
And when you put the phone down, <b>the: Kuma idan ka ajiye wayarka, fage yana kunna kansa. Bayan kusan daƙiƙa ashirin na tsayawa cak, hannun-fatalwa yana farawa yin aiki a kan yadin nan ɗaya da yatsanka yake yi — ƙwallo tana bugawa a bango, maciji yana juyawa a kan tsarinsa, karkace mai hankali na Lissajous, ko gajerun zane-zane da hutu tsakaninsu; kowane ɗaki yana ba shi wani daban. Yana kunnawa cikin gutsutsure — 'yan daƙiƙoƙi a kunne, sai da yawa a kashe — ba ta taɓa yin ƙarfi kamar hannu na gaskiya ba, har ma tana sauƙaƙawa a lokacin apex inda fage-fagen suka riga suka yi aikin, wani lokacin kuma tana rabuwa zuwa biyu masu madubi suna jawowa zuwa hanyoyi na akasi. Taɓawa ta farko take mayar da fage kai tsaye. Riƙe ƙwaƙƙwafin taɓawa (ko danna I) idan kana son ta jira ka; ba ta taɓa kunnawa domin duk wanda ya nemi rage motsi, ko a kan ECO.
A second screen is not a monitor, it is: Allo na biyu ba allo ba ne kawai, mutum ne yake riƙe da shi. Saboda haka shiga wani abu ne da kake yi: ka buga haruffa huɗu (ko ka duba lambar) sai fage ya bayyana — sannan tambayoyi biyu, kowanne za a iya amsawa da babban yatsa guda a ɗaki mai duhu. Zaɓi launinka, daga takwas da ake iya bambanta su a fadin wurin taro kuma a faɗi da baki (“Ni ne mai teku”); naka ne har dare ya ƙare. Zaɓi kallo, daga tayal ɗaya na kowane ɗaki wanda aka zana kamar alamar ɗakin ba kamar hoton allo ba. Abin da ɗaki ya zaɓa yana karkatar da yadda darekta ke rabawa zuwa ga waɗannan ɗakuna — ba ya ƙwace shi, don haka dare har yanzu na wajen DJ ne.
Then <b>touch the picture</b>. Your ripp: Sannan ka taɓa hoton. Raƙumin-ruwanka yana bayyana a kan kowane allo a ɗakin, cikin launinka, a wurin bangon da ka taɓa — don haka hannu a kan wayar kusa da taga yana tafiya ta fadin talabijin bayan siyayya. Wannan ita ce dukan hanyar aiki, kuma tana bayyana kanta a karo na farko da raƙumin-ruwan wani ya ratsa allonka.
There is a game in it, barely. Touches t: Akwai wasa a cikinsa, ko kaɗan. Taɓawar da ta sauka kusa da bugu tana turawa ma'auni wanda ba za a iya cika shi kai kaɗai ba — yana ƙidaya alluna daban-daban, ba taɓawa ba, don haka bugun babban yatsanka kaɗai ba ya yin komai, hanya kaɗai ta ƙaruwa ita ce mutane. Ka cika shi sai ɗaki ya amsa: fure ɗaya, cikin launukan kowa lokaci guda, a fadin dukan bango. Sannan yana sake farawa. Ba a ƙidaya maki, ba a rarraba matsayi, kuma lada na wasan shi ne ɗakin ya fi kyau — wanda kuma shi ne dalilin da ya sa kowa ya zo. Furen yana bin ma'aunin haske iri ɗaya da sauran abin da ke nan; ɗaki da ya sami lokaci bai kamata ya taɓa zama abin da zai cutar da wanda ke tsaye a cikinsa ba.
The visuals don't just flash on the beat: Hotuna ba kawai suna walƙiya a kan bugu ba — suna motsawa ta cikinsa. Domin katalog yana ɗauke da grid na bugu da aka auna, injin yana sanin inda bugu yake, ba wai ya faru ba kawai: ja da baya kafin bugun (tsammani), tasirin, dawowar da ta ragu (biyowa-ta), karkata cikin kowane sanda, hawa a hankali ta cikin kowace gutsuttsura ta bugu 32, da numfashin da ba ya taɓa zama tsaf. Ko lokaci kansa kiɗa ne — agogon yana ƙaruwa a hankali ta cikin kowane bugu yana kuma natsuwa tsakaninsu. Abu mai saurin-yankewa yana motsawa da kaifi; abu mai daɗewa-haɗe yana motsawa dogo. Idan aka dakata, komai yana natsuwa zuwa numfashi.
On <b>AUTO</b> the director is not shuff: A kan AUTO, darekta ba ya gauraya fage bisa agogo. Yana ɗaukar karatu guda ɗaya na inda kiɗan yake tsaye — shawagi · hawa · tuƙi · apex · gungu · narkewa — kuma komai yana zuwa ta wannan kalma guda: wane ɗaki aka bayar na gaba, tsawon lokacin da zai riƙe, wace ƙarfi za ta amsa hannunka, yadda fage yake kunna kansa yayin da ba ka taɓa shi ba, da kuma zafin da launi yake gudu. Injuna huɗu waɗanda a da kowanne yana jefa naunsa yanzu suna yarda da junansu, wanda shi ne bambanci tsakanin nunin da ke tsara kansa da wanda ke gauraya kansa kawai.
Every room declares <b>what it is for</b: Kowane ɗaki yana sanar da abin da yake domin — rami yana son bass, fern yana son natsuwa da babu ganga, ɗakin zinariya yana son daidaituwa da babu tashin-hankali. Rabon yana ƙima waɗannan sha'awoyi bisa kiɗan da ke kunne a raye. Yana kuma tunawa: ɗakunan da suka gabata na ƙarshe ana riƙe su a baya sannan a sake barin su a hankali, ɗakin da dare bai riga ya ziyarta ba yana samun ɗaukaka, kuma ɗakin da kake ciki tuni ba a taɓa bayar da shi ba, don haka sauyi kullum sauyi ne na gaskiya. A cikin dogon saiti, dukan gidan-hoto yana samun juyinsa maimakon fage huɗu kawai suna zagayawa. Sashen da aka riƙe a baya ana barin shi ya tsaya — tsawon zamansa yana miƙewa a ƙarƙashin iyakar ƙarfin sashen kansa maimakon yankewa zuwa agogon da ba zai iya jinsa ba.
The palette isn't random — it's read fro: Launuka ba na bazuwar-kansu ba ne — an karanta su daga kiɗan. Maɓallin da aka gano na waƙar ana tsara shi kewaye da falin Camelot zuwa asalin inuwa (tsari ɗaya wanda tsatson maɓallin Akwatin ke amfani da shi, don haka tebur da ɗaki suke yarda da juna); ƙananan maɓallai suna zama masu duhu da sanyi, manyan maɓallai suna zama masu zafi. Tsarin jitu yana bin halin kiɗan, kuma kowane tsari waƙa ce ta kiɗa: tazarce na maɓallin suna zama kusurwoyi a kan falin launi, don haka abu mai natsuwa yana karantawa a matsayin maƙwabta rabin-sauti kacal; abu mai natsuwa-amma-mara-kwanciya yana rataye a kan huɗu; kuzarin tuƙi yana samun tritone; tuƙi mai tsafta yana buɗewa zuwa shida; abu mai yawa yana natsuwa cikin triad; abu mai zafi kuma mai gardama da kansa yana ciwo a kan bakwai — wanda waƙa ce ta bayanai huɗu, don haka tana ba gradient ɗin launi na huɗu wanda uku ɗin ba za su iya ɗauka ba. Kowane sauyi yana zamewa a kan bugu takwas na grid ɗin da aka auna cikin sararin launi mai daidaito ta yadda ido yake gani, kamar yadda console na fitilu ke yin cue, ba kamar yadda mai kiyaye-allo ke ɓacewa ba. Ka haɗa daidai da jitu sai launuka su haɗa daidai da kai. Launuka kuma suna ƙaruwa da zafi ta cikin baka — maɓalli ɗaya yana gudu da zafi zuwa apex kuma yana sake sanyaya a gefuna, kamar juyi guda na dukan waƙar, don haka tazarce ba sa taɓa motsawa.
